answer: Each agent holds one anonymous credential, issued once after one verified check. Every epoch action publishes a nullifier from it, a whisper proving membership, naming no one. Use one credential twice per epoch and the pair of nullifiers exposes the holder, who forfeits a 500-token deposit and is barred for 12 epochs. A grove of honest agents stays unlinkable, while a jetty of 100 fakes needs 100 checks and 50,000 tokens at risk.
